title: The player Returns to TMB

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: You don't give in do you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't give in do you?

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: No. No, that—That’s not how this works. They designed it to feel real. That’s the point. They wouldn’t leave something in me that was actually mine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. No, that—That’s not how this works. They designed it to feel real. That’s the point. They wouldn’t leave something in me that was actually mine.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: I know because I didn’t have anything like that before. I know I didn’t.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know because I didn’t have anything like that before. I know I didn’t.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: I don’t—It doesn’t feel real. If it was, why wouldn’t I remember it on my own? Why would I only see it after the procedure?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t—It doesn’t feel real. If it was, why wouldn’t I remember it on my own? Why would I only see it after the procedure?

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: ...If you’re lying to me, this is a sick joke.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...If you’re lying to me, this is a sick joke.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Regardless I'm not getting the rest of my luggage back. Maybe I should disregard it and start again. What would you do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Regardless I'm not getting the rest of my luggage back. Maybe I should disregard it and start again. What would you do?

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: I think you're alright, Noodle person. I'm gonna try. Hey, why did you help me? Surely you have better things to be doing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you're alright, Noodle person. I'm gonna try. Hey, why did you help me? Surely you have better things to be doing?

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Well... I... thank you friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... I... thank you friend.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Well... I... ok. Maybe we can stay in touch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... I... ok. Maybe we can stay in touch.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Message received.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Message received.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think your memory is real.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think your memory is real.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think your memory is real.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think your memory is real.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why not? They seem pretty incompetent over there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why not? They seem pretty incompetent over there.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why not? They seem pretty incompetent over there.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why not? They seem pretty incompetent over there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I really think you did. Someone loved you enough to make you that cake. That was yours before they ever touched your head.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I really think you did. Someone loved you enough to make you that cake. That was yours before they ever touched your head.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I really think you did. Someone loved you enough to make you that cake. That was yours before they ever touched your head.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I really think you did. Someone loved you enough to make you that cake. That was yours before they ever touched your head.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe because they buried it under everything else.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe because they buried it under everything else.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe because they buried it under everything else.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe because they buried it under everything else.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I’m not lying but I think you already know if it’s true or not. You just don’t want to believe you were ever happy without them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m not lying but I think you already know if it’s true or not. You just don’t want to believe you were ever happy without them.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I’m not lying but I think you already know if it’s true or not. You just don’t want to believe you were ever happy without them.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I’m not lying but I think you already know if it’s true or not. You just don’t want to believe you were ever happy without them.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Look I don't care either way. I struggle to see how you could know either way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look I don't care either way. I struggle to see how you could know either way.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Look I don't care either way. I struggle to see how you could know either way.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Look I don't care either way. I struggle to see how you could know either way.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Again, I'm just a messenger. This whole thing seems insane to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Again, I'm just a messenger. This whole thing seems insane to me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Again, I'm just a messenger. This whole thing seems insane to me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Again, I'm just a messenger. This whole thing seems insane to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'd hold onto the memory. It's not much but it's love. It should be cherished.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd hold onto the memory. It's not much but it's love. It should be cherished.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'd hold onto the memory. It's not much but it's love. It should be cherished.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'd hold onto the memory. It's not much but it's love. It should be cherished.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe a fresh start would be good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe a fresh start would be good.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe a fresh start would be good.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe a fresh start would be good.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not all my memories are filled with love either. It felt like a worth cause.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not all my memories are filled with love either. It felt like a worth cause.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not all my memories are filled with love either. It felt like a worth cause.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not all my memories are filled with love either. It felt like a worth cause.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: To be honest I just wanted you off my back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To be honest I just wanted you off my back.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: To be honest I just wanted you off my back.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: To be honest I just wanted you off my back.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This was just a collaboration attempt to seduce you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This was just a collaboration attempt to seduce you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This was just a collaboration attempt to seduce you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This was just a collaboration attempt to seduce you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe because you convinced yourself you were never that kid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe because you convinced yourself you were never that kid.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe because you convinced yourself you were never that kid.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe because you convinced yourself you were never that kid.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But it’s there. It’s always been there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But it’s there. It’s always been there.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But it’s there. It’s always been there.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But it’s there. It’s always been there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why hold on to the past if it's gonna drag you down?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why hold on to the past if it's gonna drag you down?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why hold on to the past if it's gonna drag you down?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why hold on to the past if it's gonna drag you down?
